$comment: The roster of spec §13f, per field. The nine core roles are a floor: a field may add and may not remove. This field adds one, and it is admitted only because a ladder rung has no core owner.

sub_agents.name: literature
sub_agents.does: finds and reads prior work; produces claims with citations
sub_agents.why_separate: reading and doing must not share a context, or the agent finds what it set out to find

sub_agents.name: twin
sub_agents.does: maintains the forward model — the L2 digital twin
sub_agents.why_separate: the twin is what a method is graded against; the method's author may not own it

sub_agents.name: corpus
sub_agents.does: fetches and validates real data; refuses when absent
sub_agents.why_separate: a benchmark that silently substitutes synthetic data produces numbers that are not results

sub_agents.name: method
sub_agents.why_separate: the only role that writes the thing being judged

sub_agents.name: runner
sub_agents.does: executes runs, on leased compute when needed
sub_agents.why_separate: keeps cost and placement out of the method's hands

sub_agents.name: verifier
sub_agents.does: judges a claim against the criterion written before it
sub_agents.why_separate: independence is temporal and authorial, not informational (§13i)

sub_agents.name: reproducer
sub_agents.does: re-runs a published result from its artifacts alone
sub_agents.why_separate: catches the result that only exists on the machine that made it

sub_agents.name: teacher
sub_agents.does: derives the curriculum from the evidence chain
sub_agents.why_separate: teaching is a product and must be checkable like one

sub_agents.name: writer
sub_agents.does: assembles the field page and the paper
sub_agents.why_separate: writing last, from the record, not from intent

sub_agents.name: currency
sub_agents.does: watches guidelines, actionability databases and trial registries, and dates every model against them
sub_agents.why_separate: actionability moves monthly and static models rot silently. Nothing else in the roster has a duty that is continuous rather than per-run, and this is the clearest case in all seven fields of work that is valuable, unglamorous and unbounded in time

sub_agents.name: assay and sequencing platform
sub_agents.why_separate: an embodied act is irreversible, so it is a member of its own with its own refusal and its own grant — not a mode of a member that also does something undoable
sub_agents.refusal: refuses a specimen whose consent and provenance are not recorded

$envelope_comment: needs_envelope: a physical act (§13i). The owner declares what it may move, how far, with what, and what it must never touch; anything outside stops at GRT.
$revision: embodiment corrected against the canonical set: it is a KIND of member (reasoning / judging / embodied), not a flag on corpus, runner or reproducer. An embodied corpus could never issue its own refusal, and an embodied reproducer puts hands on a JUDGING member — the same error as an embodied verifier.
